data.name: Camariah
data.long_meaning: The name Camariah is derived from the Hebrew words 'Kamah' (God) and 'Yarah' (vow). In the Bible, the Hebrew name Camariah is mentioned in the Old Testament, in the book of Jeremiah, when the prophet Jeremiah foretold the return of the Israelites to Jerusalem and their reinstatement of the covenant with God. This name thus embodies the commitment and loyalty of those who keep their vows to God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A strong reminder of one's commitment and loyalty to God
data.numerology_meaning: A name that symbolizes nurturing, care, and love.

in_greek.name: Καμαριά
in_greek.long_meaning: Σύντομη περιγραφή: Καμαριά είναι γυναικείο όνομα που σχετίζεται με τη γη. Ετυμολογία: από το γης (γης) και/ή έγειρε (έγειρε). Ταυτόχρονα, ο χαρακτήρας της γης ως μέσου γραφής καθιστά την Καμαριά ένα κείμενο, έργο τέχνης ή ένα άτομο-έργο τέχνης. Ο συνδυασμός των λέξεων 'γης' και 'έγειρε' μπορεί να αναφέρεται σε μια ιδεατή κατάσταση ή σε κάτι που έχει δημιουργηθεί.

in_latin.name: Camariah
in_latin.long_meaning: Brevis descriptio: Camariah est nomen femininum quod ad terram spectat. Aetymologia: a terra (terra) et/aut surgeo (surgeo). Simul, caritas terrae ut medium scripturae facit Camariah textus, opus artis, aut persona- opus artis. Congerio verborum terra et surgeo potest referri ad status ideales aut creaturam.

in_english.name: Camariah
in_english.meaning: feminine name with meaning: 'earth' or 'to rise'
in_english.long_meaning: Camariah is a feminine name associated with the earth. Etymology: from earth (earth) and/or to rise (to rise). At the same time, the earth as a writing medium makes Camariah a text, work of art, or a person-work of art. The combination of the words earth and to rise may refer to an ideal state or a creation.
